threads.body: `hash_tool_definitions()` still hashes the old representation, so parameters `{1: "x"}` and `{"1": "x"}` share a filename even though the new serializer drops the former mapping and retains the latter. `_do_upload()` reuses the first file, causing references to contain the wrong definition; it also reuses pre-upgrade files containing unset optional fields as nulls. Derive a versioned cache key from the normalized upload payload, and add regression tests for both conflicting payloads and reuse of pre-upgrade files.

replies.body:
Fixed in 21320bd.

I left out a versioned key. A reused older file can differ only by `null` for unset fields, which means the same as an absent field.

A new key would re-upload every tool definition once after the upgrade.
